title: US Union Membership Rate Remains Steady at 10.0% in 2025
discussion_signal: The post circulates the BLS finding that union membership remained 10.0% in 2025 and draws reactions about the public/private-sector divide, wage comparisons, and worker disengagement. It links formal representation to perceived bargaining power without treating membership, coverage, and wage effects as the same measure.
linked_research_question: How do formal worker representation, sector structure, mobility, and perceived bargaining power shape workplace voice?
limits: LinkedIn reactions are not representative worker opinion
Membership, coverage, and wage differentials are distinct measures
The post cannot identify causal effects of union membership
